The main takeaway from our work is that
a systematic approach to protein-protein interaction targeting is possible, even for targets as large and diverse as the PDZ domain.
a combination of rational design and iterative cycles of high-throughput screening and structure-activity relationship studies can be used to identify potent and selective ligands.
